# Nirvan Sutra

## Adhyay 1: Swayam Ki Khoj

### Main Kaun Hoon?


## Pratham Khand - “Main Kaun Hoon?” Ki Pehli Dastak


### Bhumika: Yatra Kab Shuru Hoti Hai?

Adhyatma ki yatra hamesha mandir, ashram ya kisi kitab se shuru nahi hoti. Kai baar yeh yatra ek bahut sadharan si bechaini se shuru hoti hai.

Bahar se sab theek dikh raha hota hai. Kaam chal raha hota hai. Parivar hota hai. Log pehchante hain. Kabhi paisa aata hai, kabhi tareef milti hai, kabhi koi sapna bhi poora ho jata hai. Phir bhi andar kahin ek khaali-pan reh jata hai. Lagta hai jaise kuchh hai jo mil nahi raha. Jaise jeevan chal to raha hai, par koi gehra uttar abhi baaki hai.

Kai log is bechaini ko daba dete hain. Koi kaam mein aur doob jata hai. Koi rishton mein uttar dhundhta hai. Koi manoranjan mein kho jata hai. Koi naye lakshya bana leta hai. Kuchh samay ke liye mann vyast ho jata hai, par raat ke kisi shaant pal mein wahi prashn phir uthta hai: kya bas itna hi jeevan hai?

Yeh prashn kamzori ka sanket nahi hai. Yeh andar ki imaandari ka sanket hai. Jab insaan sirf jeene se santusht nahi rehta, balki jaan-na chahta hai - main kaun hoon, main dukhi kyun hota hoon, mujhe hamesha kuchh kami kyun lagti hai - tab adhyatma ki yatra shuru hoti hai.

Yeh yatra sansar se bhaagne ki yatra nahi hai. Yeh swayam se milne ki yatra hai.

Jaise koi vyakti apne hi ghar mein saalon se rahe, par use pata hi na ho ki ghar ke andar ek shaant kamra bhi hai jahan woh kabhi gaya hi nahi. Waise hi hum jeevan bhar sharir, naam, kaam, rishte aur vicharon mein rehte hain, par apne andar us shaant jaanne wali jagah ko theek se nahi dekhte jahan se sab anubhav jaane jaate hain.

Is adhyay ki shuruaat isi saral prashn se hoti hai, jo dekhne mein chhota hai, par jeevan ki jad tak jata hai: **Main kaun hoon?**


### “Main Kaun Hoon?” - Purana Prashn, Phir Bhi Har Baar Naya

“Main kaun hoon?” yeh prashn naya nahi hai. Hazaron saalon se manushya ise poochhta aaya hai. Lekin ashcharya ki baat yeh hai ki har sadhak ke jeevan mein yeh prashn pehli baar jaisa hi lagta hai.

Kyun? Kyunki yeh kitab ka prashn nahi hai. Yeh tumhare apne jeevan ka prashn hai.

Jab tak yeh prashn sirf dimag mein rehta hai, tab tak yeh philosophy jaisa lagta hai. Lekin jab jeevan mein dukh, asantosh, darr, akelapan ya gehri khoj uthti hai, tab yeh prashn bahut practical ho jata hai.

Maan lo kisi ne tumhari alochana kar di. Turant andar chot lagti hai. Prashn uthta hai - mujhe itni chot kyun lagi? Kisi ne samman diya, andar khushi uthi. Prashn uthta hai - main samman par itna dependent kyun hoon? Kisi rishte mein doori aayi, andar darr utha. Prashn uthta hai - main kis sahare jee raha hoon? Kisi din sharir bimaar hua, andar chinta uthi. Prashn uthta hai - kya main sirf yeh sharir hoon?

Dekho, hamare dukh sirf ghatnaon se nahi bante. Hamare dukh us pehchaan se bante hain jise hum “main” maan baithe hain. Agar main khud ko sirf naam maanta hoon, to naam par chot lagegi. Agar main khud ko sirf pad maanta hoon, to pad chhinne par main toot jaunga. Agar main khud ko sirf sharir maanta hoon, to sharir ke badalte hi darr shuru ho jayega. Agar main khud ko dusron ki rai se bana hua vyakti maanta hoon, to har tareef aur har ninda mujhe hila degi.

Isliye “Main kaun hoon?” sirf sochne ka vishay nahi hai. Yeh hamare roz ke dukh, rishte, darr, chahat aur insecurity se seedha juda hua prashn hai.

Aksar hum poori zindagi problems ko theek karne mein lage rehte hain, par us “main” ko nahi dekhte jise problem ho rahi hai. Jaise koi mirror mein dikh rahi dhool ko saaf karne ki koshish kare, par mirror par jami dhool ko na dekhe. Bahar ki situations badalti rehti hain, par andar ka “main” agar galat pehchaan par khada hai, to bechaini baar-baar laut aati hai.

Isliye pehla kadam hai - jaldi uttar mat do. Pehle prashn ko imaandari se suno: **Main kaun hoon?**


### Aam Uttar Aur Unki Seema

Jab kisi se poochha jata hai, “Aap kaun hain?”, to woh aam taur par koi parichay deta hai.

“Mera naam yeh hai.” “Main doctor hoon.” “Main vyapari hoon.” “Main pita hoon.” “Main maa hoon.” “Main pati hoon.” “Main patni hoon.” “Main student hoon.” “Main successful hoon.” “Main fail ho gaya hoon.”

Yeh sab uttar vyavaharik jeevan mein theek hain. Sansar mein inki zarurat hoti hai. Kisi form mein naam bharna hai, kisi kaam ke liye identity batani hai, kisi rishte mein role nibhana hai - wahan yeh uttar upyogi hain.

Lekin adhyatma ka prashn thoda gehra hai. Yahan prashn yeh nahi hai ki samaj tumhe kya kehta hai. Yahan prashn hai - in sab naamon aur roles ke pehle tum kaun ho?

Pehle naam ko dekho. Tumhara naam tumhe janm ke baad mila. Janm lete hi tumne apna naam nahi bataya tha. Parivar ne naam diya, samaj ne use sweekar kiya, aur dheere-dheere tumne bhi use apna maan liya. Naam badal bhi sakta hai. Kai log jeevan mein apna naam badalte hain. Phir bhi andar “main” ka bhaav bana rehta hai. To naam tumhara parichay ho sakta hai, par tum sirf naam nahi ho.

Ab peshe ko dekho. Koi kehta hai, “Main teacher hoon.” Koi kehta hai, “Main engineer hoon.” Koi kehta hai, “Main dukandaar hoon.” Lekin pesha badal sakta hai. Job badal sakti hai. Business badal sakta hai. Retirement ke baad pad samaapt ho sakta hai. Phir kya “main” samaapt ho jata hai? Nahi. To pesha tumhara kaam ho sakta hai, par tum sirf pesha nahi ho.

Ab rishton ko dekho. Tum kisi ke bete ho, kisi ki beti ho, kisi ke parent ho, kisi ke dost ho. Rishte sundar bhi ho sakte hain aur zaruri bhi. Lekin har rishta kisi doosre vyakti ke reference mein hai. Jab tum kehte ho “main pita hoon”, to yeh identity bachche ke reference mein hai. “Main putra hoon”, yeh mata-pita ke reference mein hai. Lekin jab tum akela shaant baithte ho, tab bhi andar “main hoon” ka anubhav rehta hai. Us pal koi role nibhana zaruri nahi hota, phir bhi tumhara hona bana rehta hai. To rishte tumhari roles ho sakte hain, par tum sirf role nahi ho.

Ab achievements ko dekho. Kabhi jeevan mein success milti hai, kabhi failure. Kabhi log tareef karte hain, kabhi bhool jate hain. Kabhi hum apne aap ko bahut yogya maante hain, kabhi bahut chhota mehsoos karte hain. Agar main apni achievements se bana hoon, to achievement ghatte hi main bhi ghat jaunga. Agar main failure se bana hoon, to success aate hi main badal jaunga. Lekin kya andar ka “main” har success aur failure ke saath sach mein badal jata hai? Ya sirf mann ki sthiti badalti hai?

Ise kapdon se samjho. Ek vyakti alag-alag kapde pehnta hai. Kabhi safed, kabhi rangin, kabhi purane, kabhi naye. Kapde badalte hain, par pehnne wala wahi rehta hai. Isi tarah naam, pesha, rishta aur achievements jeevan ke kapdon jaise hain. Unka samman karo, par unhe apna antim swaroop mat maan lo. Jo badal sakta hai, woh tumhara poora satya nahi ho sakta.


### Sharir Main Nahi Hoon - Pehla Kadam

Ab hum thoda aur paas aate hain.

Aksar insaan apne sharir ko hi “main” maan leta hai. Yeh bahut swabhavik bhi lagta hai, kyunki sharir hamare saath har samay dikhai deta hai. Jab koi kehta hai “main thak gaya”, to woh sharir ki thakaan ko apna anubhav maanta hai. Jab sharir bimaar hota hai, hum kehte hain “main bimaar hoon.” Jab sharir sundar ya asundar lagta hai, to andar garv ya heenata uthti hai.

Lekin shaant hokar dekho - kya tum sirf sharir ho?

Bachpan ki apni koi photo yaad karo. Chhota sharir, chhoti ungliyan, alag chehra, alag awaaz, alag chal. Phir kishoravastha aayi. Sharir badla. Phir yuvaavastha aayi. Sharir aur badla. Umar badhti hai to sharir phir badalta hai.

Sharir har samay badal raha hai. Jo sharir paanch saal ki umar mein tha, woh ab nahi hai. Phir bhi jab tum us bachche ki photo dekhte ho, to sahaj kehte ho - “yeh main hoon.” Kaise?

Sharir badal gaya. Chehra badal gaya. Awaaz badal gayi. Pasand badal gayi. Vichar badal gaye. Phir bhi “main” ka koi gehra bhaav bana raha.

Iska arth yeh nahi ki sharir ki upeksha karni hai. Sharir jeevan ka ek pavitra sadhan hai. Iski dekhbhaal karni chahiye. Ise swasth rakhna chahiye. Lekin sadhan ko swami maan lena bhool hai.

Gaadi ka example lo. Tum car mein baithkar yatra karte ho. Car tumhe ek jagah se doosri jagah le jati hai. Car kharab ho jaye to yatra kathin ho jati hai. Isliye car ki dekhbhaal zaruri hai. Lekin kya tum car ho? Nahi. Car tumhara vehicle hai. Isi tarah sharir is life-journey ka vehicle hai. Iska samman karo, iski raksha karo, par ise hi “main” mat maan lo.

Ek aur example lo - mirror ka. Mirror mein tumhara chehra dikhai deta hai. Agar mirror mein chehra thaka hua dikhe, to tum jaante ho ki mirror sirf dikha raha hai. Mirror tum nahi ho. Usi tarah sharir mein umar, rog, sundarta, thakaan, shakti - yeh sab dikhai dete hain. Par kya in sabko jaanne wala bhi sharir hi hai?

Jab tum kehte ho “mera sharir thaka hua hai”, to dhyan se suno - yeh vaakya khud bata raha hai ki sharir “mera” hai. Jo “mera” hai, woh “main” kaise ho sakta hai? Tum kehte ho “mera haath”, “meri aankhen”, “mera chehra”, “mera sharir”. Jaise tum kehte ho “mera ghar”, “meri kitab”, “mere kapde”. Ghar tumhara hai, par tum ghar nahi ho. Kapde tumhare hain, par tum kapde nahi ho. Usi tarah sharir tumhara hai, par kya tum sharir ho?

Yeh baat sirf dimag se maan lene ki nahi hai. Ise apne experience mein dekhna hai.

Abhi kuchh pal rukkar apne haath ko dekho. Haath dikhai de raha hai. Ab aankhen band karke sharir ki sensations ko mehsoos karo. Kahin heaviness hai, kahin lightness, kahin warmth, kahin heartbeat. Yeh sab experience mein aa raha hai. Ab saral prashn poochho - jo in sensations ko jaan raha hai, kya woh khud sensation hai?

Sharir experience mein aata hai. Sharir badalta hai. Sharir jaana jata hai. To kya jaanne wala bhi sirf sharir ho sakta hai?

Yahi “Main kaun hoon?” ki pehli real seedhi hai. Hum abhi kisi bade conclusion par nahi pahunch rahe. Jaldi nahi karenge. Bas itna dekhenge ki sharir badalta hai, aur main us badlav ko jaanta hoon.

Jaise aakash mein badal badalte rehte hain. Kabhi safed, kabhi kaale, kabhi tez, kabhi halke. Par aakash badalon ke saath badal nahi jata. Abhi humein sirf itna dekhna hai ki sharir mein badlav aate-jaate hain, par andar “main hoon” ka anubhav bana rehta hai.


### Sapne Ka Chhota Example

Raat mein sapna aata hai. Sapne mein tumhara ek sharir hota hai. Tum daudte ho, darte ho, khush hote ho, logon se milte ho. Us samay sapna bahut real lagta hai. Lekin jaagne par pata chalta hai ki sapne ka sharir aur sapne ki duniya waking point of view se permanent nahi thi.

Yeh example sirf itna dikhane ke liye hai ki experience kitna bhi real lage, phir bhi uski jaanch ki ja sakti hai. Din ka sharir sapne jaisa kehna yahan uddeshya nahi hai. Uddeshya sirf yeh hai: adhyatma andhvishwas nahi kehta. Woh kehta hai - dekho, par gehra dekho.


### Pehla Darwaza Khulta Hai

Ab tak humne koi kathin baat nahi kahi. Sirf jeevan ko shaant hokar dekha.

Humne dekha ki naam badal sakta hai. Pesha badal sakta hai. Rishton ki role badal sakti hai. Achievements badal sakti hain. Sharir bhi bachpan se ab tak badalta aaya hai. Phir bhi ek “main hoon” ka anubhav bana rehta hai.

Yahi khoj ki shuruaat hai.

Abhi yeh kehne ki zarurat nahi ki “main yeh hoon” ya “main woh hoon.” Abhi sirf itna dekhna hai ki jinhe main ab tak “main” maanta tha, unmein bahut kuchh badalne wala hai. Woh jeevan mein upyogi hain, par mera antim satya nahi ho sakte.

Is samajh ko zabardasti mat banao. Isse belief mat banao. Bas ise apne jeevan mein dekhna shuru karo.

Jab sharir healthy ho, tab dekho. Jab sharir thaka ho, tab dekho. Jab sharir sundar lage, tab dekho. Jab sharir asahaj lage, tab bhi dekho.

Har baar saral prashn poochho: **Yeh sharir badal raha hai. Par jo ise jaan raha hai, woh kaun hai?**

Agle kadam mein khoj mann ki taraf badhegi - vichar, bhavna, smriti, darr, ichchha aur kalpana. Hum dekhenge ki kya main mann hoon, ya mann bhi sharir ki tarah jaana jaane wala ek badalta hua pravah hai.


### Aaj Ke Liye Abhyas

Aaj din mein teen baar rukkar sirf 30 seconds ke liye yeh dekho:

**Abhi mere sharir mein kya experience ho raha hai - thakaan, halka-pan, tension, aaram, heartbeat ya koi sensation? Aur jo in sabko jaan raha hai, kya woh bhi sharir ki tarah badal raha hai?**

Uttar banane ki jaldi mat karo. Bas dekho. Yahi dekhna khoj ki shuruaat hai.


## Dwitiya Khand - Kya Main Mann Hoon?


### Sharir Se Mann Ki Taraf

Prashn abhi bhi wahin khada hai: **agar sharir main nahi hoon, to phir main kya hoon?**

Humne dekha ki sharir badalta hai. Bachpan ka sharir aaj ka sharir nahi hai, phir bhi “main hoon” ka bhaav bana raha. Lekin jaise hi sadhak sunta hai ki “main sharir nahi hoon”, mann turant agla uttar de deta hai - “to phir main mann hoon.”

Yahi agla vichar hai. Sharir bahar se dikhai deta hai, par mann andar chalta hai. Vichar apne lagte hain. Bhavnaen personal lagti hain. Smritiyan hamari kahani banati lagti hain. Ichchha aur darr jeevan ko chalate lagte hain. Isliye mann ko “main” maan lena bahut natural lagta hai.

Jab hum kehte hain “main dukhi hoon”, “main chintit hoon”, “main soch raha hoon”, “main khush hoon”, to lagta hai ki mann hi main hoon. Lekin kya yeh sach hai? Kya mann sach mein mera antim swaroop hai, ya mann bhi ek badalta hua pravah hai jise main jaan sakta hoon? Chalo dheere-dheere dekhte hain.


### Mann Kya Hai?

Mann ko samajhne ke liye kisi bhaari psychology ki zarurat nahi hai. Nirvan Sutra mein mann ka arth hai - andar chalne wala pravah, jisme vichar, bhavnaen, smritiyan, kalpana, ichchha aur darr uthte hain.

Kabhi mann future ki chinta karta hai. Kabhi past ko repeat karta hai. Kabhi kisi ki baat se dukhi ho jata hai. Kabhi imagination mein sukh dhundhta hai. Kabhi kuchh paana chahta hai. Kabhi kuchh khone se darta hai. Yeh sab milkar mann ka pravah banate hain.

Mann nadi jaisa hai. Nadi ka paani har pal badal raha hota hai, phir bhi hum use ek hi nadi kehte hain. Mann bhi aisa hi hai. Vichar badalte hain, bhavnaen badalti hain, ichchhaen badalti hain, darr badalte hain, par hum kehte hain - “mera mann.”

“Mera mann” kehna bhi ek sanket hai. Jaise hum kehte hain “mera ghar”, “mera phone”, “meri kitab”, waise hi hum kehte hain “mera mann.” Iska matlab yeh nahi ki mann bekaar hai. Mann bahut upyogi hai. Mann se hum seekhte hain, plan banate hain, language samajhte hain, rishte nibhate hain, decisions lete hain.

Lekin upyogi cheez ko apna antim swaroop maan lena bhram ki shuruaat hai. Mann sadhan hai. Mann experience ka field hai. Mann badalta hua pravah hai. Par kya mann “main” hoon? Is prashn ko jaldi mat niptao. Ise apne experience mein dekho.


### Mann Kitna Badalta Hai

Ek sadharan din ko dekho.

Subah aankh khulti hai. Agar neend achchhi aayi hai, to mann halka hai. Lagta hai aaj bahut kuchh kar lenge. Phir phone mein koi message dikh jata hai. Achanak chinta aa jati hai. Thodi der baad chai milti hai, mausam achchha lagta hai, mann phir theek ho jata hai.

Dopahar tak kaam ka pressure aata hai. Mann thakne lagta hai. Koi vyakti kuchh teekha bol de, to irritation uthti hai. Phir achanak kisi purane dost ka message aa jata hai, mann prasann ho jata hai. Shaam ko koi purani baat yaad aa jati hai, andar udaasi uthti hai. Raat mein koi achchha vichar aata hai, mann hopeful ho jata hai.

Ek hi din mein mann kitni baar badal gaya.

Subah utsaah tha. Phir chinta aayi. Phir aaram aaya. Phir chidh aayi. Phir khushi aayi. Phir udaasi aayi. Phir aasha aayi.

Ab shaant hokar poochho - agar main mann hoon, to main din mein kitni baar badal gaya?

Jab mann khush tha, kya main sirf khushi tha? Jab mann dukhi hua, kya main poori tarah dukh ban gaya? Jab mann gusse mein tha, kya mera poora astitva gussa tha? Jab mann shaant hua, kya main pehli baar paida hua?

Nahi. Kuchh hai jo in sab states ko jaanta hai.

Mann weather jaisa badalta hai. Kabhi dhoop, kabhi badal, kabhi tez hawa, kabhi baarish. Weather badalta hai, lekin ghar ke andar baitha vyakti keh sakta hai - “bahar baarish hai” ya “aaj dhoop hai.” Usi tarah andar koi jagah hai jahan se hum keh sakte hain - “aaj mann bhaari hai”, “abhi mann shaant hai”, “abhi mann mein darr uth raha hai.”

Is sentence ko dhyan se dekho: **mere mann mein darr hai.** Agar darr hi main hota, to main kaise jaanta ki darr hai? Agar vichar hi main hota, to main kaise kehta ki vichar chal rahe hain? Agar mann hi main hota, to mann ke badalne ko kaun dekhta? Yahin se khoj gehri hone lagti hai.


### Vicharon Ko Dekhne Wala Kaun Hai?

Ab vicharon ko dekho.

Ek vichar kehta hai, “mujhe yeh karna chahiye.” Doosra kehta hai, “nahi, yeh mushkil hai.” Teesra kehta hai, “agar main fail ho gaya to?” Chautha kehta hai, “shayad sab theek ho jayega.” Mann mein vicharon ki ek poori meeting chalti rehti hai. Kabhi ek vichar bolta hai, kabhi doosra. Hum aksar kisi ek vichar ko pakad lete hain aur use sach maan lete hain. Phir usi ke saath behne lagte hain.

Lekin kya tumne kabhi sirf vichar ko aate hue dekha hai?

Jaise road par vehicles aate-jaate hain. Car aayi, bus aayi, bike aayi, phir sab aage nikal gaye. Road ke kinare khade hokar tum vehicles ko dekh sakte ho. Agar tum har vehicle mein baith jao, to tum kheechte chale jaoge. Vichar bhi aise hi aate-jaate hain. Ek vichar aaya, kuchh der raha, phir doosra aa gaya. Tumhe har vichar mein baithna nahi hai.

Yahan hum “saakshi” shabd ko bahut halke se samjhenge. Saakshi ka arth hai - woh shaant jaanne wali upasthiti jo dekhti hai. Abhi is shabd ko theory mat banao. Sirf apne experience mein dekho ki vichar dikh raha hai. Agar vichar jaana ja raha hai, to jaanne wala vichar se alag hona chahiye.

Jo dekha ja raha hai, woh dekhne wala nahi ho sakta. Vichar dekhe ja rahe hain. Vichar badal rahe hain. Vichar aate hain, jaate hain. To kya main sirf vichar hoon?

Yeh prashn mann ko rokne ke liye nahi hai. Mann se ladne ke liye nahi hai. Yeh sirf dekhne ke liye hai ki vichar aate-jaate hain, aur unke aane-jaane ko jaanne wali koi shaant upasthiti hai.

Cinema screen ka example lo. Screen par film chalti hai. Kabhi war scene, kabhi love scene, kabhi dukh, kabhi hansi, kabhi andhera, kabhi light. Scenes badalte rehte hain, par screen apni jagah rehti hai. Scenes screen par aate hain, par screen scene nahi ban jati. Mann mein bhi vicharon ki film chalti rehti hai. Hum aam taur par film mein kho jate hain. Sadhana ka pehla sanket hai ki hum thodi der ke liye film ko film ki tarah dekh saken.


### Ek Chhota Abhyas: Ek Vichar Ko Aate Dekhna

Abhi ek minute ke liye rukna kaafi hai.

Aaram se baitho. Koi special posture zaruri nahi hai. Sharir ko natural rehne do. Aankhen band kar sakte ho, ya khuli bhi rakh sakte ho.

Mann ko rokne ki koshish mat karo. Vicharon ko hatane ki koshish mat karo. Koi special spiritual experience lane ki koshish mat karo.

Bas wait karo.

Koi na koi vichar aayega. Shayad yeh vichar aaye - “main sahi kar raha hoon ya nahi?” Shayad koi kaam yaad aaye. Shayad koi vyakti yaad aaye. Shayad yeh vichar aaye ki “kuchh bhi nahi ho raha.”

Jo bhi vichar aaye, use pakdo mat. Use dhakka bhi mat do. Bas mann hi mann dekho: **ek vichar aaya.**

Phir woh vichar chala jaye, to dekho: **vichar chala gaya.**

Phir doosra vichar aaye, to phir dekho: **doosra vichar aaya.**

Is abhyas mein tumhe vicharon se jeetna nahi hai. Tumhe bas yeh dekhna hai ki vichar apne aap aate hain aur apne aap jaate hain. Tum unhe jaan sakte ho.

Jaise railway station par baitha vyakti trains ko aate-jaate dekhta hai. Har train mein baithna zaruri nahi hai. Usi tarah har vichar tumhara order nahi hai. Har vichar tumhari identity nahi hai. Har vichar satya nahi hai. Woh sirf mann mein uthi ek gati hai.

Yahi dekhna mann se thodi distance lata hai. Yeh distance bhaagna nahi hai. Yeh clarity hai.


### Bhavnaon Ki Jaanch

Ab bhavnaon ko dekho.

Vicharon ki tarah bhavnaen bhi aati-jaati hain, par woh zyada powerful lagti hain. Vichar kabhi halka hota hai, bhavna poore sharir aur mann par chha jati hai. Gussa aata hai to lagta hai main hi gussa hoon. Darr aata hai to lagta hai main hi darr hoon. Dukh aata hai to lagta hai main dukh se bana hoon. Khushi aati hai to lagta hai bas yahi main hoon.

Lekin dhairya se dekho.

Gussa aaya tha. Phir kuchh samay baad kam hua. Darr utha tha. Phir dheere-dheere badal gaya. Dukh bhaari laga tha. Phir ek din halka ho gaya. Khushi aayi thi. Phir woh bhi chali gayi.

Bhavnaen experience mein sachchi hoti hain. Unhe jhooth mat banao. Dukh hai to dukh ko dabao mat. Darr hai to usse naakaro mat. Gussa hai to use holy naam dekar chhupao mat. Sadhana ka arth imaandari hai.

Lekin imaandari ka arth yeh bhi hai ki hum dekhein - bhavna aayi hai, par kya woh permanent hai?

Tumne jeevan mein kitni bhavnaen jee hain. Bachpan ke darr, purani khushiyan, purane dukh, purani ichchhaen - kitni cheezen aayi aur chali gayi. Agar woh sab tum hi the, to unke jaane par tum bhi chale jaane chahiye the. Lekin tum rahe.

Do sentences ko dekho: “main dukhi hoon” aur “dukh ka experience ho raha hai.” Pehle mein identity tight ho jati hai. Doosre mein dekhne ki jagah khul jati hai.

Dukh ko dekhkar bhi sensitive raha ja sakta hai. Darr ko dekhkar bhi shaant raha ja sakta hai. Gusse ko dekhkar bhi turant uske peeche bhaagna zaruri nahi hai. Yahi sadhana ki shuruaat hai.

Bhavnaen samundar ki lehron jaisi hain. Lehar uthti hai, failti hai, phir shaant ho jati hai. Lehar ko naakara nahi ja sakta, par lehar poore samundar ka antim satya nahi hai. Usi tarah bhavna experience mein aati hai, par tumhara poora satya nahi ho sakti.


### Mann Ko Shatru Mat Banao

Yahan ek baat bahut zaruri hai. Yeh mat samajhna ki mann bura hai. Mann ko shatru bana lena sadhana nahi hai. Mann life ke liye zaruri hai. Mann se hi bhasha samajh aati hai. Mann se hum seekhte hain, kaam karte hain, plan banate hain, rishte nibhate hain.

Problem mann mein nahi hai. Problem mann ko “main” maan lene mein hai.

Mobile phone useful hai. Usse baat hoti hai, kaam hota hai, information milti hai. Lekin agar koi vyakti mobile mein itna kho jaye ki aas-paas ki duniya hi bhool jaye, to problem phone nahi, identification hai. Mann bhi aisa hi hai. Mann ka use karo, par mann mein khoo mat. Vicharon ka use karo, par vicharon ko apna swaroop mat banao. Bhavnaon ka samman karo, par unse apni final identity mat banao.

Dheere-dheere sadhak samajhne lagta hai ki mann badalta hai, aur main uske badlav ko jaan sakta hoon. Yeh samajh abhi final gyaan nahi hai, par direction sahi hai.


### Doosra Darwaza

Pehle humne sharir ko dekha. Sharir badalta hai. Ab humne mann ko dekha. Mann bhi badalta hai.

Vichar aate hain aur chale jaate hain. Bhavnaen uthti hain aur shaant ho jaati hain. Smritiyan aati hain, kalpana banti hai, ichchhaen badalti hain, darr badalte hain. Mann ka weather har din, har ghante, kabhi-kabhi har minute badalta rehta hai.

Phir bhi kuchh hai jo is sabko jaanta hai.

Jab sharir thaka tha, woh jaana gaya. Jab sharir halka tha, woh jaana gaya. Jab vichar aaye, woh jaane gaye. Jab vichar gaye, woh bhi jaana gaya. Jab dukh aaya, woh jaana gaya. Jab khushi aayi, woh bhi jaani gayi.

To ab prashn aur gehra ho gaya hai: **agar sharir bhi main nahi, mann bhi main nahi - to phir jo dono ko jaan raha hai, woh kya hai?**

Yahin se agla kadam shuru hota hai. Ab hum is jaanne wali upasthiti ko aur clear dekhenge. Saath hi us “main” ko bhi dekhenge jo kehta hai - “main soch raha hoon”, “main kar raha hoon”, “mujhe experience ho raha hai.” Yahin se saakshi aur anubhavkarta ka antar khulna shuru hoga.


### Aaj Ke Liye Abhyas

Aaj jab bhi koi teekha vichar ya bhavna uthe - jaise chinta, gussa, darr, dukh ya jaldi - turant use rokne ki koshish mat karo.

Sirf 20 seconds rukkar mann mein itna kaho:

**Yeh vichar uth raha hai.
Yeh bhavna uth rahi hai.**

Phir shaant hokar poochho: **jo ise jaan raha hai, kya woh bhi isi vichar ya bhavna jaisa badal raha hai?**

Uttar banane ki jaldi mat karo. Sirf dekho. Vichar aur bhavna aate-jaate hain. Dekhna bana rehta hai.


## Tritiya Khand - Saakshi Aur Anubhavkarta Ka Antar


### Jaanne Wale Ki Or

Ab prashn hamare saamne hai: **agar sharir bhi main nahi, mann bhi main nahi - to phir jo sharir aur mann dono ko jaan raha hai, woh kya hai?**

Sharir jaana jata hai. Mann jaana jata hai. Vichar jaane jaate hain. Bhavnaen jaane jaati hain. Yahan tak ki “mujhe yeh experience ho raha hai” wala bhaav bhi notice kiya ja sakta hai. To ab khoj seedhe jaanne wale ki taraf mudti hai.

Yeh pehli adhyay ka heart hai. Bhasha simple rahegi, par clarity bahut zaruri hai. Kuchh imagine nahi karna. Sirf usko dekhna hai jo pehle se experience mein maujood hai.


### Saakshi Kya Hai?

Nirvan Sutra mein us shaant jaanne wali upasthiti ko **saakshi** kaha jayega.

Saakshi sharir ko jaanta hai. Saakshi mann ko jaanta hai. Saakshi vicharon ko aate-jaate dekhta hai. Saakshi sukh, dukh, darr, gussa, ichchha aur uljhan ko jaanta hai.

Lekin saakshi khud in sabse badalta nahi.

Jab sharir mein thakaan hoti hai, thakaan jaani jaati hai. Jab sharir mein aaram hota hai, aaram jaana jata hai. Jab mann mein khushi hoti hai, khushi jaani jaati hai. Jab mann mein dukh hota hai, dukh jaana jata hai. Thakaan badli, aaram badla, khushi badli, dukh badla. Lekin jaanne ki upasthiti bani rahi.

Saakshi kuchh karta nahi. Woh sirf jaanta hai.

Saakshi vicharon ko rokta nahi. Saakshi bhavnaon ko dabata nahi. Saakshi sharir ko chhodta nahi. Saakshi sansar se bhaagta nahi. Saakshi bas jaanta hai ki yeh sab experience ho raha hai.

Ek common confusion hota hai: log sochte hain ki saakshi banna matlab patthar jaisa chup ho jana, koi emotion na hona, koi vichar na aana, life se cut jana. Aisa nahi hai.

Saakshi-bhaav ka matlab life band ho jana nahi hai. Matlab hai - life chalti rahe, par andar clarity ho ki main aane-jaane wale experiences mein khoya hua nahi hoon.

Vichar aa sakte hain. Bhavnaen uth sakti hain. Sharir kaam kar sakta hai. Rishte nibhaye ja sakte hain. Baat-cheet ho sakti hai. Par andar ek shaant jaanna bana rehta hai. Yahi saakshi ki pehli pehchaan hai.


### Anubhavkarta Kya Hai?

Ab humein ek bahut zaruri bhed samajhna hai. Saakshi aur anubhavkarta ek nahi hain.

**Anubhavkarta** experience ke star par uthne wala woh vyaktigat kendra hai jahan experience “mera experience” ki bhasha leta hai. Sharir mein dard ho, to vyavahar mein kehna padta hai - “mujhe dard hai.” Mann mein dukh uthe, to kaha jata hai - “mujhe dukh hai.” Dhyan mein shanti aaye, to kaha jata hai - “mujhe shanti ka anubhav hua.”

Yahan anubhavkarta ko ahankar samajhkar turant dosh mat do. Anubhavkarta life ke vyavahar mein upyogi hai. Samvad, upchar, seekh, rishte aur sadhana - in sab mein anubhavkarta ki bhasha chalti hai. Samasya uske hone mein nahi hai.

Samasya tab shuru hoti hai jab anubhavkarta kisi experience se kathor identity bana leta hai. “Mujhe dukh hua” badalkar “main dukh hi hoon” ban jata hai. “Mujhe success mili” badalkar “main superior hoon” ban jata hai. “Mujhe shanti ka experience hua” badalkar “main jag gaya hoon” ban jata hai. Yahin ahankar ki parat judti hai.

Saakshi in sabko jaanta hai. Saakshi jaanta hai - dukh ka experience ho raha hai. Saakshi jaanta hai - gussa uth raha hai. Saakshi jaanta hai - tareef sunkar mann prasann hua. Saakshi jaanta hai - alochana sunkar mann mein chot uthi. Saakshi experience ko jaanta hai, par usse kathor identity nahi banata.

Isliye is adhyay mein bhed bahut saaf rakho:

**Anubhavkarta experience ka kendra hai.
Ahankar experience se bani kathor identity hai.
Saakshi dono ko jaanne wali shaant upasthiti hai.**

Yeh antar bahut subtle bhi hai aur bahut practical bhi. Agar yeh antar clear ho jaye, to sadhana ki direction badal jaati hai.


### Example One: Talaab Aur Lehron Ka Antar

Ek shaant talaab ki kalpana karo.

Talaab ka jal sthir hai. Phir koi chhota sa patthar usmein girta hai. Jal mein lehrain uthti hain. Lehrain failti hain. Kuchh der tak jal hilta hai. Phir dheere-dheere shaant ho jata hai.

Ab is example ko apne andar dekho.

Koi vyakti kuchh kathor bol deta hai. Andar ek patthar gira. Mann mein lehrain uthi - dukh ki lehar, gusse ki lehar, bachav ki lehar, jawab dene ki lehar.

Anubhavkarta turant kehta hai - “mujhe chot lagi. Usne mere saath aisa kiya. Main apmaanit ho gaya.”

Saakshi dekhta hai - “mann mein chot ki lehar uth rahi hai. Sharir mein kasav hai. Vichar jawab dena chahte hain. Dukh ka experience ho raha hai.”

Ghatna wahi hai. Lehrain wahi hain. Mann ki halchal wahi hai. Par anubhavkarta lehron se identity bana leta hai. Saakshi lehron ko jaanta hai.

Iska matlab yeh nahi ki lehrain buri hain. Iska matlab yeh bhi nahi ki life mein patthar kabhi na gire. Ghatnaen hongi. Log bolenge. Situations badalengi. Mann mein reaction uthega.

Sadhana ka arth lehron se ladna nahi hai. Sadhana ka arth hai dekhna ki lehar uth rahi hai, par main sirf lehar nahi hoon.

Talaab mein lehar uthti hai, par jal ki gehraai turant samaapt nahi ho jaati. Usi tarah mann mein dukh ya gussa uthta hai, par jaanne wali shaant upasthiti nasht nahi hoti.


### Example Two: Patra Aur Padhne Wala

Maan lo tumhare paas kuchh letters aate hain.

Ek letter mein tareef likhi hai. Padhte hi mann prasann ho jata hai. Doosre letter mein criticism hai. Mann bhaari ho jata hai. Teesre mein chinta ki khabar hai. Darr uthta hai. Chauthe mein achchhi news hai. Utsaah aa jata hai.

Letters badalte gaye. Unke words badalte gaye. Mann ki reactions bhi badalti gayi.

Lekin letters padhne wala har letter ko jaan raha tha.

Anubhavkarta letter ki baat mein poori tarah ulajh jata hai. Tareef wale letter mein phool jata hai. Criticism wale letter mein toot jata hai. Darr wale letter mein kaampne lagta hai. Achchhi news wale letter mein uchhalne lagta hai.

Saakshi letter padhne ko jaanta hai. Woh mann ki reaction ko bhi jaanta hai.

Woh jaanta hai - “tareef padhkar mann mein khushi uthi.” Woh jaanta hai - “criticism padhkar mann mein sikudan aayi.” Woh jaanta hai - “darr ki news se body mein tension aaya.” Woh jaanta hai - “achchhi baat se mann mein prasannata aayi.”

Yahan bhi ghatna ko naakara nahi gaya. Reaction ko dabaya nahi gaya. Sirf identity badal gayi.

Anubhavkarta kehta hai - “main hi yeh reaction hoon.” Saakshi jaanta hai - “yeh reaction experience mein aa rahi hai.” Yahi antar andar ki freedom kholta hai.


### Anubhavkarta Bura Nahi Hai

Yahan bahut saavdhani chahiye. Anubhavkarta ko bura mat maano. Usse ladna mat shuru karo. Use dabane ki koshish mat karo. Anubhavkarta jeevan ke vyavahar mein bani hui vyaktigat bhasha ka hissa hai. Yeh wahi “main” hai jo kehta hai - “mujhe yeh experience hua”, “mujhe yeh seekh mili”, “mujhe dukh hai”, “mujhe sahayata chahiye.”

Vyavahar mein iski zarurat hai. Agar sharir ko upchar chahiye, to kehna padega - “mujhe dard hai.” Agar mann mein dukh hai, to kehna padega - “mujhe dukh hai.” Agar sadhana mein koi baat clear hui, to kaha ja sakta hai - “mujhe samajh ki jhalak mili.” Ismein koi dosh nahi.

Sadhana ka uddeshya anubhavkarta se yuddh karna nahi hai. Uddeshya sirf yeh dekhna hai ki anubhavkarta antim satya nahi hai. Aur jab anubhavkarta kisi experience se kathor identity bana leta hai, tab ahankar ki parat judti hai.

Jaise-jaise saakshi-bhav clear hota hai, sadhak anubhavkarta ko bhi dekh sakta hai. Woh dekh sakta hai - “abhi andar woh ‘main’ uth raha hai jise samman chahiye.” Woh dekh sakta hai - “abhi dukh ka experience hai, aur mann use kahani banana chahta hai.” Woh dekh sakta hai - “abhi garv uth raha hai.” Woh dekh sakta hai - “abhi darr uth raha hai.”

Yeh dekhna bahut komal hai. Ismein kathorta nahi hai. Ismein judgment nahi hai. Ismein sirf clarity hai.


### Ahankar Ka Halka Parichay

Ab ek aur shabd ko bahut halke se samajhna hoga - **ahankar**. Nirvan Sutra mein ahankar ka arth hai woh “main” ki dharna jo sharir, mann, naam, kahani aur role ko apna real swaroop maan leti hai.

Saral bhasha mein, ahankar kehta hai - “main sharir hoon.” “Mere vichar hi main hoon.” “Meri kahani hi main hoon.” “Meri success hi main hoon.” “Meri chot hi main hoon.” “Mere experiences hi main hoon.”

Yahan anubhavkarta aur ahankar ka antar phir yaad rakho. Anubhavkarta kehta hai - “mujhe experience hua.” Ahankar kehta hai - “yeh experience hi meri identity hai.” Anubhavkarta vyavahar mein upyogi kendra hai. Ahankar us kendra ke aas-paas bani hui kathor identity hai.

Saakshi vastav mein badalkar ahankar nahi ban jata. Saakshi achal jaanne wali upasthiti hai. Lekin mann mein aisi galat pehchaan uthti hai ki “main sharir-mann hoon.” Isi galat pehchaan se ahankar ki paratein banti hain, aur anubhavkarta experiences se zyada chipakne lagta hai.

Abhi humein ahankar par bahut detail mein nahi jana hai. Aage ke adhyayon mein ise gehra samjha jayega. Abhi sirf itna jaan-na kaafi hai ki anubhavkarta ko shatru nahi manana hai, ahankar ki pakad ko dekhna hai, aur saakshi in dono se pehle ki shaant jaanne wali upasthiti hai.


### Practical Abhyas: Haal Ki Ghatna Ko Dekho

Ab ek chhota self-observation karo. Yeh meditation mein baithne wala abhyas nahi hai. Yeh apne life ko saaf dekhne ka abhyas hai.

Aaj ya kal ki koi chhoti ghatna yaad karo.

Shayad kisi ne tumhari baat nahi suni. Shayad kisi ne tumhari tareef ki. Shayad kisi ne tumhe tok diya. Shayad ghar mein koi chhoti inconvenience hui. Shayad phone par koi message dekhkar mann badal gaya.

Ab us ghatna ko yaad karte hue teen prashn poochho:

**Pehla prashn:** us samay sharir mein kya hua tha? Shayad chehra garam hua. Shayad chest mein kasav aaya. Shayad saans tez hui. Shayad sharir halka hua.

**Doosra prashn:** us samay mann mein kya vichar aur bhavna uthi thi? Shayad gussa, dukh, darr, garv, khushi ya kuchh aur.

**Teesra prashn:** us samay main poori tarah anubhavkarta ki tarah ulajh gaya tha, ya thoda sa dekh pa raha tha ki yeh sab mere andar ghat raha hai?

Yahan apne aap ko blame mat do. Agar tum poori tarah ulajh gaye the, tab bhi theek hai. Yeh dekhna hi shuruaat hai.

Sadhana ka arth yeh nahi ki life mein kabhi reaction na uthe. Sadhana ka arth hai - reaction uthne ke baad bhi ek din tum use dekh sako. Dheere-dheere reaction uthte samay bhi dekh sako. Phir dheere-dheere reaction uthne se pehle bhi ek chhota sa viraam aa jaye. Wahi viraam saakshi-bhaav ka darwaza hai.


### Roz Ki Zindagi Mein Saakshi-Bhaav

Saakshi-bhaav koi mysterious experience nahi hai. Yeh koi aisi cheez nahi jise paane ke liye pahadon mein jana pade. Yeh tumhare life mein pehle se maujood hai, bas dhyan nahi gaya.

Jab koi tumhe kuchh kathor kehta hai aur tum turant jawab dene ke bajay ek pal ruk jaate ho - us rukne mein saakshi-bhaav ki jhalak hai.

Jab din bahut busy hai, kaam bahut hai, log bahut bol rahe hain, phir bhi andar kahin ek chhota sa shaant kona mehsoos hota hai - yeh saakshi-bhaav ki jhalak hai.

Jab mann mein dukh hai, lekin tum itna dekh pa rahe ho ki “dukh uth raha hai” - yeh saakshi-bhaav ki jhalak hai.

Jab khushi aati hai aur tum use pakadne ki bechaini ke bina experience kar paate ho - yeh bhi saakshi-bhaav ki jhalak hai.

Jab galti ho jaati hai aur tum apne aap ko poori tarah blame karne ke bajay saaf dekh paate ho ki “yeh galti hui, isse seekhna hai” - wahan bhi saakshi-bhaav ki shuruaat hai.

Saakshi-bhaav life se distance nahi banata. Balki life ko aur clear dekhne ki capacity deta hai.

Anubhavkarta life mein ulajhta hai. Saakshi life ko jaanta hai. Anubhavkarta har ghatna se identity banata hai. Saakshi har ghatna ko aate-jaate dekhta hai. Anubhavkarta kehta hai, “main toot gaya.” Saakshi jaanta hai, “tootne ka experience uth raha hai.” Anubhavkarta kehta hai, “main bahut bada hoon.” Saakshi jaanta hai, “garv ka experience uth raha hai.”

Yeh fark chhota lagta hai, lekin jeevan mein bahut bada badlav laata hai.


### Saakshi Ko Special Experience Mat Banao

Kabhi sadhak ko meditation ya shaant state mein bahut achchha experience hota hai. Mann shaant ho jata hai, sharir halka lagta hai, andar anand hota hai. Phir woh kehta hai - “mujhe saakshi ka experience hua.”

Shuruaat mein yeh baat theek lag sakti hai, par saavdhani chahiye. Jo experience aaya aur gaya, woh bhi experience hai. Saakshi woh hai jo us experience ko bhi jaanta hai.

Shanti aayi, jaani gayi. Anand aaya, jaana gaya. Khaali-pan aaya, jaana gaya. Gahra experience aaya, jaana gaya.

Isliye saakshi ko kisi special experience mein mat baandho. Saakshi koi chamakdar ghatna nahi hai. Saakshi woh jaanna hai jisme har ghatna jaani jaati hai.

Mann ise special banana chahta hai. Mann kehta hai, “mujhe kuchh bada experience hona chahiye.” Anubhavkarta kehta hai, “mujhe gyaan hona chahiye.” Lekin saakshi pehle se jaan raha hai ki yeh chah bhi uth rahi hai.

Isliye dheere chalo. Special experiences ke peeche bhaagne ki jaldi mat karo. Abhi sirf itna dekho - jo bhi experience hai, woh jaana ja raha hai.


### Khoj Ka Heart

Ab tak humne yatra ke teen kadam dekhe.

Pehle sharir ko dekha. Sharir badalta hai. Phir mann ko dekha. Mann badalta hai. Ab humne us jaanne wali upasthiti ki taraf mudna shuru kiya jo sharir aur mann dono ko jaanti hai.

Isi ko Nirvan Sutra mein saakshi kaha jayega.

Saakshi shaant jaanne wali upasthiti hai. Woh sharir, mann, vichar, bhav, sukh aur dukh ko jaanta hai. Woh khud inse badalta nahi. Woh kuchh karta nahi, sirf jaanta hai.

Aur humne dekha ki anubhavkarta alag hai. Anubhavkarta experiences se judta hai. Woh kehta hai - “main dukhi hoon”, “maine kiya”, “mujhe chot lagi”, “mujhe gyaan hua.” Woh experiences ko apna maanta hai. Woh badalta rehta hai.

Yeh antar samajhna “Swayam Ki Khoj” ka heart hai.

Abhi yeh samajh sirf shuruaat hai. Ise life mein stable hona hai. Purani aadat bahut strong hai. Hum baar-baar sharir se identity banate hain, mann se identity banate hain, anubhavkarta mein laut jaate hain. Ismein koi dosh nahi. Yahi sadhana ka field hai.

Ab hum dekhenge ki is samajh ko roz ke jeevan mein kaise sambhala jaaye, taaki saakshi-bhaav kisi special meditation tak limited na rahe, balki chalne, bolne, sunne aur kaam karne mein bhi yaad rahe.


### Aaj Ke Liye Abhyas

Aaj kisi ek ghatna ko chuno jisme tum thoda ulajh gaye the - koi baat-cheet, koi message, koi chhoti naarazgi, koi chinta, ya koi tareef.

Kagaz par ya mann mein teen lines dekho:

**Ghatna kya thi?
Usmein anubhavkarta ne kya kaha - “main dukhi hoon”, “main sahi hoon”, “mujhe maan chahiye”, ya kuchh aur?
Us poori ghatna ko abhi shaant hokar kaun jaan raha hai?**

Uttar ko sundar banane ki koshish mat karo. Bas imaandari se dekho. Yahi dekhna saakshi-bhaav ka abhyas hai.


## Chaturth Khand - Samajh Ko Jeevan Mein Sthir Karna


### Samajh Se Jeevan Tak

Ab humne is pehli adhyay ki sabse mahatvapurn disha ko chhoo liya hai. Sharir jaana jata hai. Mann jaana jata hai. Anubhavkarta bhi jaana jata hai. Aur in sabko jaanne wali shaant upasthiti ko Nirvan Sutra mein saakshi kaha gaya.

Yeh samajh sunne mein simple lag sakti hai, lekin daily life mein ise yaad rakhna dheere-dheere aata hai.

Samajh aana ek baat hai. Samajh ko jeena doosri baat hai. Samajh ko har din, har situation, har reaction ke beech yaad rakhna - yahi sadhana hai.

Ab prashn sirf yeh nahi hai ki saakshi kya hai. Ab prashn hai ki jab life apni normal speed mein chalti hai - ghar, kaam, rishte, responsibilities, chinta, thakaan, tareef, criticism - tab is samajh ko kaise zinda rakha jaye.

Kyunki sadhana sirf shaant room mein baithkar hone wali baat nahi hai. Sadhana wahi poori hoti hai jahan life chalti hai.


### Purani Aadat Strong Hai - Yeh Normal Hai

Sabse pehle ek baat bahut prem se samajhni hai: tum baar-baar bhoologe.

Kabhi saakshi-bhaav clear lagega. Phir thodi der baad koi chhoti baat hogi aur tum phir anubhavkarta mein ulajh jaoge. Koi kuchh bol dega, mann turant reaction karega. Koi darr uthega, tum usse jud jaoge. Koi tareef milegi, andar garv uthega. Koi criticism milega, andar chot lagegi.

Phir shayad baad mein yaad aayega - “main to dekhna chahta tha, par main phir ulajh gaya.” Us pal apne aap ko blame mat dena.

Yeh failure nahi hai. Yeh sirf purani aadat ka lautna hai.

Saalon se, shayad poori life se, humne sharir aur mann ko hi “main” maana hai. Humne har vichar ko serious liya hai. Har bhavna ke saath beh gaye hain. Har ghatna ko apni kahani bana liya hai. Anubhavkarta ki aadat bahut purani hai.

Ek example lo. Agar koi vyakti saalon tak jhuk kar baithta raha ho, to uski body usi posture ki aadat bana leti hai. Phir ek din woh decide karta hai ki ab seedha baithna hai. Kuchh minute seedha baithta hai, phir bina jaane phir jhuk jata hai. Kya iska matlab woh fail ho gaya? Nahi. Body purani aadat mein laut gayi. Use dheere-dheere, prem se, baar-baar yaad dilana hoga.

Andar ki aadat bhi aisi hi hai. Mann baar-baar purani identity banayega. Anubhavkarta baar-baar uthega. Ahankar kahega - “main hi yeh sharir-mann hoon.” Ghatnaen tumhe kheenchengi.

Lekin ab farq itna hai ki tumhare paas dekhne ki direction aa gayi hai. Pehle tum ulajhte the aur bas ulajhe rehte the. Ab tum ulajhoge, lekin kabhi-kabhi dekh bhi loge ki uljhan ho rahi hai. Yahi bada change hai.

Sadhana mein harshness ki zarurat nahi hai. Prem, dhairya aur imaandari ki zarurat hai. Bhool gaye? Phir yaad karo. Ulajh gaye? Phir dekho. Reaction ho gayi? Baad mein use shaant hokar pehchano. Yahi path hai.


### Saakshi-Bhaav Ko Kaise Yaad Rakhein

Saakshi-bhaav ko yaad rakhne ke liye koi heavy discipline zaruri nahi hai. Shuruaat mein chhote-chhote reminders kaafi hain. Inhe rules ki tarah mat lo. Inhe burden mat banao. Inhe apne andar lautne ke chhote darwaze samjho.

**1. Din mein kuchh baar ruko.** Din mein do ya teen baar sirf kuchh pal ke liye ruko aur poochho: “abhi main anubhavkarta ki tarah uljha hoon, ya saakshi ki tarah dekh raha hoon?” Agar jawab aaye - “main uljha hoon” - tab bhi theek hai. Uljhan ko dekh lena hi saakshi-bhaav ki shuruaat hai.

**2. Teekhi reaction se pehle ek saans.** Jab koi baat chubh jaye, jab gussa uthe, jab jawab dene ki jaldi ho, tab sirf ek saans ka viraam lo. Saans andar gayi. Saans bahar aayi. Itna chhota pause bhi bahut bada ho sakta hai. Us ek saans mein tum dekh sakte ho - “mann react karna chahta hai”, “body mein kasav aaya hai”, “anubhavkarta hurt feel kar raha hai.”

**3. Raat ko do minute.** Sone se pehle do minute baitho. Poore din ka analysis zaruri nahi hai. Sirf teen baatein yaad karo: aaj kab main poori tarah anubhavkarta mein ulajh gaya? Aaj kab mujhe saakshi-bhaav ki thodi jhalak mili? Aaj kis pal maine sharir ya mann ko experience ki tarah dekha?

**4. Bhavna ko naam do, identity mat banao.** Jab koi emotion uthe, to turant “main” mat bano. Dheere se kaho: “gussa uth raha hai”, “darr uth raha hai”, “dukh ka experience ho raha hai”, “mann mein bechaini hai”, “body mein tension hai.” Yeh chhota sa shift bahut useful hai. “Main dukhi hoon” identity ko strong karta hai. “Dukh ka experience ho raha hai” dekhne ki jagah kholta hai.

Yeh sirf language ka game nahi hai. Yeh identification ki direction badalta hai. Dheere-dheere mann samajhne lagta hai ki har bhavna final truth nahi hai. Bhavna aati hai, rehti hai, aur chali jaati hai. Use jaana ja sakta hai.


### Puri Adhyay Ki Yatra Ka Saar

Ab is pehli adhyay ki yatra ko ek baar shaant hokar dekho.

Shuruaat mein humne sharir ki jaanch ki. Humne dekha ki sharir bachpan se ab tak badalta aaya hai. Sharir jeevan ka sadhan hai, par sharir ko hi final “main” maan lena adhura uttar hai.

Phir humne mann ki jaanch ki. Vichar, bhavnaen, smritiyan, ichchhaen aur darr - yeh sab mann ka pravah hain. Mann bahut upyogi hai, par mann bhi har din badalta hai. Isliye mann bhi permanent “main” nahi ho sakta.

Phir humne saakshi aur anubhavkarta ka antar dekha. Anubhavkarta experiences se judta hai aur kehta hai - “mujhe dukh hua”, “maine kiya”, “mujhe chot lagi”, “mujhe gyaan hua.” Saakshi sirf jaanta hai ki experience ho raha hai. Woh sharir, mann, vichar, bhav, sukh aur dukh ko jaanta hai, par khud inse badalta nahi.

Yahi is adhyay ki mool disha hai:

**Sharir badalta hai.
Mann badalta hai.
Anubhavkarta experiences se judta hai.
Saakshi jaanta hai.**

Aur swayam ki khoj isi saakshi-bhaav ki or lautne se shuru hoti hai.


### Aage Nirvan Sutra Mein Kya Aata Hai?

“Swayam Ki Khoj” Nirvan Sutra Nirvan Sutra ki pehli adhyay hai. Iska kaam tha tumhe bahar ki identity se andar ki khoj ki taraf modna. Ab tumne dekhna shuru kiya hai ki sharir aur mann ko jaana ja sakta hai, aur saakshi-bhaav mein theharne ki direction possible hai.

Aage aane wali adhyay is foundation ko aur gehra karengi.

Ek adhyay mein hum Maya aur jagat ko samjhenge - yeh sansar itna real kyun lagta hai, aur phir bhi final truth kyun nahi hai.

Ek adhyay mein hum saakshi-bhaav ko aur detail mein dekhenge - sirf idea ki tarah nahi, balki life ke beech awareness ki tarah.

Ek adhyay mein hum ahankar ki layers ko samjhenge - woh “main” kaise banta hai jo sharir, mann, kahani, achievement, chot aur experiences se apni identity bana leta hai.

Nirvan Sutra ka poora Nirvan Sutra aath adhyay mein phaila hua hai. Har adhyay ek seedhi hai. Koi seedhi competition mein badi ya chhoti nahi hai. Har seedhi zaruri hai. Dheere chalne se hi foundation strong hota hai.

Jab sadhak sabhi aath adhyay poori kar lega, tab ek online examination hogi. Is exam ka uddeshya darana nahi hai. Yeh school wali pressure exam nahi hai jahan sadhak ko prove karna pade ki woh doosron se better hai. Yeh next doorway ki tarah hai.

Isse dekha jayega ki sadhak ne baaton ko sirf padha hai, ya unhe apne experience mein thoda-thoda dekhna shuru kiya hai. Exam ki review guru swayam karenge. Yeh review rokne ke liye nahi, sahi direction mein aage badhane ke liye hogi.

Exam pass karne ke baad sadhak ko Nirvan Dham ke private group mein entry milegi. Wahan yatra akeli nahi rahegi. Wahan guidance, samvad aur anya serious sadhako ke saath yeh samajh life mein aur stable ho sakegi.

Isliye exam ko obstacle mat samjho. Use welcome door samjho. Ismein fear ki zarurat nahi, imaandari ki zarurat hai.


### Dheere Chalna Hi Sahi Chalna Hai

Is path mein jaldi ka koi sthan nahi hai.

Mann jaldi answer chahta hai. Anubhavkarta jaldi achievement chahta hai. Ahankar jaldi keh dena chahta hai - “mujhe samajh aa gaya.” Lekin swayam ki khoj mein jaldbazi aksar surface par hi rakh deti hai.

Dheere chalo.

Ek-ek baat ko life mein dekho. Sharir ko dekho. Mann ko dekho. Bhavnaon ko dekho. Reactions ko dekho. Anubhavkarta ko dekho. Aur baar-baar us shaant jaanne wali upasthiti ki or lauto.

Yeh lautna hi abhyas hai.

Kabhi tum clear lagoge. Kabhi lagega sab bhool gaye. Kabhi mann shaant hoga. Kabhi bahut uljha hoga. Yeh sab journey ka hissa hai. Inmein se kisi ko final judgment mat bana lena.

Jo padha hai, use life mein lana hi asli learning hai.

Jab koi tumhe samajh na paye, tab dekho. Jab koi tumhari tareef kare, tab dekho. Jab sharir thak jaye, tab dekho. Jab mann bechain ho, tab dekho. Jab andar shanti ho, tab bhi dekho. Kyunki saakshi sirf kathin samay mein nahi, sukh ke samay mein bhi pehchana jata hai.


### Antim Ashirvachan

Priya sadhak, tumne is pehli adhyay mein ek bahut mahatvapurn kadam rakha hai.

Tumne bahar ki identity se andar ki khoj ki taraf mudna shuru kiya hai. Yeh chhota kadam nahi hai. Bahut log jeevan bhar naam, kaam, rishte, success, failure aur mann ki stories mein hi uljhe rehte hain. Lekin jab andar yeh prashn imaandari se uthta hai - “main kaun hoon?” - tab life ki direction badalne lagti hai.

Is prashn ko sambhal kar rakhna.

Ise sirf kitab ke pages mein mat chhod dena. Ise apne din mein le jana. Apne rishte mein le jana. Apni reactions mein le jana. Apne silence mein le jana. Apni thakaan aur apni khushi dono mein le jana.

Yeh koi race nahi hai. Yeh koi performance nahi hai. Yeh spiritual achievements collect karne ki yatra nahi hai.

Yeh swayam mein lautne ki yatra hai.

Dheere chalna hi sahi chalna hai. Imaandari se dekhna hi sadhana hai. Baar-baar bhoolkar bhi laut aana hi progress hai.

Tumhare andar woh shaant jaanne wali upasthiti abhi bhi hai. Woh kabhi door nahi gayi. Sirf dhyan bahar uljha raha. Ab dheere-dheere dhyan laut raha hai.

Yatra jaari rahegi. Nirvan Sutra ki agli adhyay mein hum is samajh ko sansar, Maya aur jagat ki taraf le jayenge. Wahan hum dekhenge ki jo bahar itna solid aur heavy lagta hai, woh andar ki identity se kaise juda hai.

Abhi ke liye, is pehli adhyay ko yahin prem se poora karo. Jo samjha hai, use turant prove karne ki koshish mat karo. Bas aane wale dino mein use life mein dekhne ki anumati do.

Yahi kaafi hai. Yahi aarambh hai. Yahi darwaza hai.


### Is Hafte Ke Liye Abhyas

Agle saat din tak sirf ek halka abhyas karo.

Din mein teen baar rukkar apne aap se poochho:

**Abhi main kis se identity bana raha hoon - sharir se, mann se, anubhavkarta se, ya saakshi ki tarah dekh pa raha hoon?**

Aur raat mein sone se pehle do minute yaad karo:

**Aaj kab main ulajh gaya?
Aaj kab mujhe dekhne ki halki jhalak mili?
Aaj kis pal maine experience ko experience ki tarah dekha, apna final swaroop nahi maana?**

Ise rule mat banao. Ise burden mat banao. Ise apne andar lautne ka prem-purn nimantran banao.

Yahi is pehli adhyay ka abhyas hai. Yahi agle kadam ki taiyari hai.

Jab tak yeh prashn sirf dimag mein rehta hai, tab tak yeh philosophy jaisa lagta hai. Lekin jab jeevan mein dukh, asantosh, darr, akelapan ya gehri khoj uthti hai, tab yeh prashn bahut practical ho jata hai.

Maan lo kisi ne tumhari alochana kar di. Turant andar chot lagti hai. Prashn uthta hai - mujhe itni chot kyun lagi? Kisi ne samman diya, andar khushi uthi. Prashn uthta hai - main samman par itna dependent kyun hoon? Kisi rishte mein doori aayi, andar darr utha. Prashn uthta hai - main kis sahare jee raha hoon? Kisi din sharir bimaar hua, andar chinta uthi. Prashn uthta hai - kya main sirf yeh sharir hoon?

Dekho, hamare dukh sirf ghatnaon se nahi bante. Hamare dukh us pehchaan se bante hain jise hum “main” maan baithe hain. Agar main khud ko sirf naam maanta hoon, to naam par chot lagegi. Agar main khud ko sirf pad maanta hoon, to pad chhinne par main toot jaunga. Agar main khud ko sirf sharir maanta hoon, to sharir ke badalte hi darr shuru ho jayega. Agar main khud ko dusron ki rai se bana hua vyakti maanta hoon, to har tareef aur har ninda mujhe hila degi.

Isliye “Main kaun hoon?” sirf sochne ka vishay nahi hai. Yeh hamare roz ke dukh, rishte, darr, chahat aur insecurity se seedha juda hua prashn hai.

Aksar hum poori zindagi problems ko theek karne mein lage rehte hain, par us “main” ko nahi dekhte jise problem ho rahi hai. Jaise koi mirror mein dikh rahi dhool ko saaf karne ki koshish kare, par mirror par jami dhool ko na dekhe. Bahar ki situations badalti rehti hain, par andar ka “main” agar galat pehchaan par khada hai, to bechaini baar-baar laut aati hai.

Isliye pehla kadam hai - jaldi uttar mat do. Pehle prashn ko imaandari se suno: Main kaun hoon?

Aam Uttar Aur Unki Seema

Jab kisi se poochha jata hai, “Aap kaun hain?”, to woh aam taur par koi parichay deta hai.

“Mera naam yeh hai.” “Main doctor hoon.” “Main vyapari hoon.” “Main pita hoon.” “Main maa hoon.” “Main pati hoon.” “Main patni hoon.” “Main student hoon.” “Main successful hoon.” “Main fail ho gaya hoon.”

Yeh sab uttar vyavaharik jeevan mein theek hain. Sansar mein inki zarurat hoti hai. Kisi form mein naam bharna hai, kisi kaam ke liye identity batani hai, kisi rishte mein role nibhana hai - wahan yeh uttar upyogi hain.

Lekin adhyatma ka prashn thoda gehra hai. Yahan prashn yeh nahi hai ki samaj tumhe kya kehta hai. Yahan prashn hai - in sab naamon aur roles ke pehle tum kaun ho?

Pehle naam ko dekho. Tumhara naam tumhe janm ke baad mila. Janm lete hi tumne apna naam nahi bataya tha. Parivar ne naam diya, samaj ne use sweekar kiya, aur dheere-dheere tumne bhi use apna maan liya. Naam badal bhi sakta hai. Kai log jeevan mein apna naam badalte hain. Phir bhi andar “main” ka bhaav bana rehta hai. To naam tumhara parichay ho sakta hai, par tum sirf naam nahi ho.

Ab peshe ko dekho. Koi kehta hai, “Main teacher hoon.” Koi kehta hai, “Main engineer hoon.” Koi kehta hai, “Main dukandaar hoon.” Lekin pesha badal sakta hai. Job badal sakti hai. Business badal sakta hai. Retirement ke baad pad samaapt ho sakta hai. Phir kya “main” samaapt ho jata hai? Nahi. To pesha tumhara kaam ho sakta hai, par tum sirf pesha nahi ho.

Ab rishton ko dekho. Tum kisi ke bete ho, kisi ki beti ho, kisi ke parent ho, kisi ke dost ho. Rishte sundar bhi ho sakte hain aur zaruri bhi. Lekin har rishta kisi doosre vyakti ke reference mein hai. Jab tum kehte ho “main pita hoon”, to yeh identity bachche ke reference mein hai. “Main putra hoon”, yeh mata-pita ke reference mein hai. Lekin jab tum akela shaant baithte ho, tab bhi andar “main hoon” ka anubhav rehta hai. Us pal koi role nibhana zaruri nahi hota, phir bhi tumhara hona bana rehta hai. To rishte tumhari roles ho sakte hain, par tum sirf role nahi ho.

Ab achievements ko dekho. Kabhi jeevan mein success milti hai, kabhi failure. Kabhi log tareef karte hain, kabhi bhool jate hain. Kabhi hum apne aap ko bahut yogya maante hain, kabhi bahut chhota mehsoos karte hain. Agar main apni achievements se bana hoon, to achievement ghatte hi main bhi ghat jaunga. Agar main failure se bana hoon, to success aate hi main badal jaunga. Lekin kya andar ka “main” har success aur failure ke saath sach mein badal jata hai? Ya sirf mann ki sthiti badalti hai?

Ise kapdon se samjho. Ek vyakti alag-alag kapde pehnta hai. Kabhi safed, kabhi rangin, kabhi purane, kabhi naye. Kapde badalte hain, par pehnne wala wahi rehta hai. Isi tarah naam, pesha, rishta aur achievements jeevan ke kapdon jaise hain. Unka samman karo, par unhe apna antim swaroop mat maan lo. Jo badal sakta hai, woh tumhara poora satya nahi ho sakta.

Sharir Main Nahi Hoon - Pehla Kadam

Ab hum thoda aur paas aate hain.

Aksar insaan apne sharir ko hi “main” maan leta hai. Yeh bahut swabhavik bhi lagta hai, kyunki sharir hamare saath har samay dikhai deta hai. Jab koi kehta hai “main thak gaya”, to woh sharir ki thakaan ko apna anubhav maanta hai. Jab sharir bimaar hota hai, hum kehte hain “main bimaar hoon.” Jab sharir sundar ya asundar lagta hai, to andar garv ya heenata uthti hai.

Lekin shaant hokar dekho - kya tum sirf sharir ho?

Bachpan ki apni koi photo yaad karo. Chhota sharir, chhoti ungliyan, alag chehra, alag awaaz, alag chal. Phir kishoravastha aayi. Sharir badla. Phir yuvaavastha aayi. Sharir aur badla. Umar badhti hai to sharir phir badalta hai.

Sharir har samay badal raha hai. Jo sharir paanch saal ki umar mein tha, woh ab nahi hai. Phir bhi jab tum us bachche ki photo dekhte ho, to sahaj kehte ho - “yeh main hoon.” Kaise?

Sharir badal gaya. Chehra badal gaya. Awaaz badal gayi. Pasand badal gayi. Vichar badal gaye. Phir bhi “main” ka koi gehra bhaav bana raha.

Iska arth yeh nahi ki sharir ki upeksha karni hai. Sharir jeevan ka ek pavitra sadhan hai. Iski dekhbhaal karni chahiye. Ise swasth rakhna chahiye. Lekin sadhan ko swami maan lena bhool hai.

Gaadi ka example lo. Tum car mein baithkar yatra karte ho. Car tumhe ek jagah se doosri jagah le jati hai. Car kharab ho jaye to yatra kathin ho jati hai. Isliye car ki dekhbhaal zaruri hai. Lekin kya tum car ho? Nahi. Car tumhara vehicle hai. Isi tarah sharir is life-journey ka vehicle hai. Iska samman karo, iski raksha karo, par ise hi “main” mat maan lo.

Ek aur example lo - mirror ka. Mirror mein tumhara chehra dikhai deta hai. Agar mirror mein chehra thaka hua dikhe, to tum jaante ho ki mirror sirf dikha raha hai. Mirror tum nahi ho. Usi tarah sharir mein umar, rog, sundarta, thakaan, shakti - yeh sab dikhai dete hain. Par kya in sabko jaanne wala bhi sharir hi hai?

Jab tum kehte ho “mera sharir thaka hua hai”, to dhyan se suno - yeh vaakya khud bata raha hai ki sharir “mera” hai. Jo “mera” hai, woh “main” kaise ho sakta hai? Tum kehte ho “mera haath”, “meri aankhen”, “mera chehra”, “mera sharir”. Jaise tum kehte ho “mera ghar”, “meri kitab”, “mere kapde”. Ghar tumhara hai, par tum ghar nahi ho. Kapde tumhare hain, par tum kapde nahi ho. Usi tarah sharir tumhara hai, par kya tum sharir ho?

Yeh baat sirf dimag se maan lene ki nahi hai. Ise apne experience mein dekhna hai.

Abhi kuchh pal rukkar apne haath ko dekho. Haath dikhai de raha hai. Ab aankhen band karke sharir ki sensations ko mehsoos karo. Kahin heaviness hai, kahin lightness, kahin warmth, kahin heartbeat. Yeh sab experience mein aa raha hai. Ab saral prashn poochho - jo in sensations ko jaan raha hai, kya woh khud sensation hai?

Sharir experience mein aata hai. Sharir badalta hai. Sharir jaana jata hai. To kya jaanne wala bhi sirf sharir ho sakta hai?

Yahi “Main kaun hoon?” ki pehli real seedhi hai. Hum abhi kisi bade conclusion par nahi pahunch rahe. Jaldi nahi karenge. Bas itna dekhenge ki sharir badalta hai, aur main us badlav ko jaanta hoon.

Jaise aakash mein badal badalte rehte hain. Kabhi safed, kabhi kaale, kabhi tez, kabhi halke. Par aakash badalon ke saath badal nahi jata. Abhi humein sirf itna dekhna hai ki sharir mein badlav aate-jaate hain, par andar “main hoon” ka anubhav bana rehta hai.

Sapne Ka Chhota Example

Raat mein sapna aata hai. Sapne mein tumhara ek sharir hota hai. Tum daudte ho, darte ho, khush hote ho, logon se milte ho. Us samay sapna bahut real lagta hai. Lekin jaagne par pata chalta hai ki sapne ka sharir aur sapne ki duniya waking point of view se permanent nahi thi.

Yeh example sirf itna dikhane ke liye hai ki experience kitna bhi real lage, phir bhi uski jaanch ki ja sakti hai. Din ka sharir sapne jaisa kehna yahan uddeshya nahi hai. Uddeshya sirf yeh hai: adhyatma andhvishwas nahi kehta. Woh kehta hai - dekho, par gehra dekho.

Pehla Darwaza Khulta Hai

Ab tak humne koi kathin baat nahi kahi. Sirf jeevan ko shaant hokar dekha.

Humne dekha ki naam badal sakta hai. Pesha badal sakta hai. Rishton ki role badal sakti hai. Achievements badal sakti hain. Sharir bhi bachpan se ab tak badalta aaya hai. Phir bhi ek “main hoon” ka anubhav bana rehta hai.

Yahi khoj ki shuruaat hai.

Abhi yeh kehne ki zarurat nahi ki “main yeh hoon” ya “main woh hoon.” Abhi sirf itna dekhna hai ki jinhe main ab tak “main” maanta tha, unmein bahut kuchh badalne wala hai. Woh jeevan mein upyogi hain, par mera antim satya nahi ho sakte.

Is samajh ko zabardasti mat banao. Isse belief mat banao. Bas ise apne jeevan mein dekhna shuru karo.

Jab sharir healthy ho, tab dekho. Jab sharir thaka ho, tab dekho. Jab sharir sundar lage, tab dekho. Jab sharir asahaj lage, tab bhi dekho.

Har baar saral prashn poochho: Yeh sharir badal raha hai. Par jo ise jaan raha hai, woh kaun hai?

Agle kadam mein khoj mann ki taraf badhegi - vichar, bhavna, smriti, darr, ichchha aur kalpana. Hum dekhenge ki kya main mann hoon, ya mann bhi sharir ki tarah jaana jaane wala ek badalta hua pravah hai.
